name: Isometric
pitch: A friendly architecture walkthrough where the infrastructure itself is the cast: code, tables, and numbers become chunky little solids on a warm floor.

illustration.medium: flat vector isometric illustration on off-white, like a technical product diagram
illustration.line: 2px strokes, precise isometric angles (30 degrees), no freehand curves
illustration.shapes: isometric boxes, servers, and simple 3D-style blocks built from flat facets
illustration.texture: none, flat color facets with a slightly darker shade on one face to suggest depth
illustration.palette_use: off-white background dominant, deep navy line work, one teal accent used for the highlighted facet or element
illustration.avoid: gradients, true perspective/vanishing points, photorealism, hand-drawn wobble
